_comment: Curated label fonts, shipped as a manifest: scripts/fonts.py downloads them from Google Fonts (all SIL OFL) on first use and caches them. 'weight' is the one recommended for labels; single-weight families are 400. display_only = fine for a short word or two, poor for item names. Curated 2026-11-14.

defaults.pairing: IBM Plex Sans and Heebo are both neutral grotesques with similar x-height and stroke weight at Bold, so a mixed Hebrew/Latin label reads as one face.

latin.use: Default. Neutral, compact, very legible on tape.
Covers Latin and Hebrew in one face; good for mixed labels.
Maximum legibility for small tape and distant reading.
Condensed: fits long names on short labels.
Rounded, soft; household and kids' labels.
Monospace for serials, asset numbers and codes.
Very heavy single weight for one-word headings.
All-caps condensed; short words, shelf and bin codes.

hebrew.use: Default. Clean grotesque Hebrew with matching Latin; pairs with IBM Plex Sans.
Both scripts in one face; the safe choice for mixed text.
Slightly narrower than Heebo; fits longer words.
Rounded corners, friendly, strong at small sizes.
Arial-metric Hebrew and Latin; plain and familiar.
Heavy single weight; reads well big and small.
Classic Hebrew serif; formal or traditional labels.
Fun drippy effect; a word or two only.
